div.div:
How not to download twice or loop forever
• Normalization: one page — one URL.
• URL Seen? — Bloom filter: "no" is exact, "yes" is wrong ~1% of the time. We lose a few new URLs but never download twice.
• Content Seen?: ~30% of web pages are duplicates under different URLs.
• Traps: URL length > 2048, depth > 15, > 10,000 pages per host per day, repeated path segments (/a/b/a/b/).
• The Kafka offset is committed after processing: on a crash the event comes again, dedup makes the retry safe.
